newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Arco upgraded, FY97 eps raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Arco upgraded, FY97 eps raised.

text.p: -- Dean Witter analyst Eugene Nowak said he upgraded Atlantic Richfield Co to an accumulate from neutral.
-- said raised fiscal year 1997 estimate to $9.50 per share from $9.25 per share.
-- said set price target of $143 over next six to 12 months.
-- "We thought concerns about the fourth quarter were overdone and did not reflect the overall positive outlook on the company," Nowak said.
-- said company's shares were trading near their lows and presented a good buying opportunity.
-- Arco shares were up 5-1/2 to 136-3/8 in late trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
